subject: general
question:
In the following graph the production of Raggi in 4 consecutive years are plotted. In which year the production of Raggi is maximum?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7eea5118652e8b227905df9e01602bba44f7823ef1a90150d706b640ced517e.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The production of Raggi in 2017 = 4000

The production of Raggi in 2018 = 4500

The production of Raggi in 2019 = 3000

The production of Raggi in 2020 = 2500

**Calculation:**

We can see that the relation among production of Raggi in different year is,

⇒ 2018 > 2017 > 2019 > 2020

**∴ The required result will be 2018.**
